stem: Roots appear discolored and growth has slowed while the medium stays saturated for extended periods. Which investigation is most appropriate before diagnosing a nutrient deficiency?
choices: Evaluate moisture duration, aeration/drainage, root condition and disease indicators together
Assume saturation cannot affect root function
rationale: Prolonged saturation can reduce aeration and contribute to root dysfunction or disease. Nutritional-looking symptoms should be differentiated from physical and biological root-zone causes.
